access.notes: Installable via pip or conda. Must support RHF, ROHF, CI methods, and effective core potentials.

access.notes: A double‑zeta quality basis set (e.g., cc‑pVDZ for oxygen, ECP10MDF for Ti) can be fetched from Basis Set Exchange or bundled with the quantum chemistry package.
